verdict.rationale: Asana offers AI Studio for no-code automations, Rules/webhooks/API for custom workflows, and AI Teammates with shared memory and governance that could be configured to triage/prioritize work, plus integrations (e.g., Sentry, GitHub) that create tasks from bug reports. However, there is no direct evidence of a specific 'triage and prioritize incoming bugs/tasks' AI feature — it relies on generic automation building blocks rather than a demonstrated out-of-the-box triage capability. Missing for 10: concrete example or documentation of an AI Teammate/Studio workflow that auto-triages and prioritizes bugs, and independent confirmation it works as intended.
